eli: Heads-up — hotfix PR #9120 touches kv-cache warmup. Need a second sign-off before tonight's 21:00 PT cutoff. CI is green except a flaky latency test.
sonya: On it, linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9120 — quick skim now.
ajay: Is this safe for a canary? What's rollback plan?
eli: Canary yes: 5% traffic for 30m then ramp. Rollback is `scripts/rollback.sh` + instant autoscaling fallback.
eli: Failing test snippet I saw earlier:
```text
[ RUN      ] LatencyTest.P95Spike
error: p95 > threshold (340ms > 300ms)
```
sonya: I see one subtle race in `kv_warmup.cpp` (line ~214) — will push a tiny fix and request CI.
sonya: Pushed `fix/race-9120` with a comment-only refactor and an extra mutex guard.
sonya: Re-run CI?
deploy-bot: CI triggered for branch fix/race-9120 — running unit, integration, e2e (expected ~12m).
ben (oncall): I can give my sign-off after CI passes and a quick smoke in staging. Tagging @maria as backup reviewer.
maria: I can jump on this in ~20m. If CI is green by then I can do a second pass.
deploy-bot: CI passed on fix/race-9120 — all checks ✅ (unit: ok, int: ok, e2e: flaky but within tolerance).
ben (oncall): Approved — patch looks good, test additions are reasonable. :thumbsup:
maria: Approved — sanity pass on staging completed, canary plan looks good.
eli: Great, two approvals obtained. Scheduling canary at 20:30 PT, will post rollout updates here and abort if p95 regresses. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
